files.rejection_reason: REF-A15 asks for books, scrolls and written pages readable at close range. This is a wide Ashlands shot with scrolls scattered on the ground at roughly 30 px; neither the page nor the Daedric script can be read.

1920x1080 at 0.35 bits/pixel — an order of magnitude below the 6-9 bits/pixel of the other RDR2 and Witcher 3 captures. Heavily recompressed; measuring it would measure the recompressor. Also HUD-bearing.

Genuine Skyrim SE frame but a large "SKYRIM SPECIAL EDITION / BEAUTIFICATION PROJECT" text lockup is burned into the pixels. Text is high-contrast synthetic geometry: it inflates M4 edge density and destroys the M8 flat-shading and M5 spectral statistics. Also a modded install.
Same text lockup. Additionally near-black silhouette composition — M1 would read as crushed.
Same text lockup, and the subject is an aurora sky with a silhouette; effectively a title card, not a gameplay frame.
